contrecoup.definition:
n. A concussion or shock produced by a blow or other
   injury, in a part or region opposite to that at which the blow is
   received, often causing rupture or disorganisation of the parts
   affected.
contrecoup.translation: n. [医]对侧伤, 对侧外伤

contredanse.definition:
n a type of folk dance in which couples are arranged in sets or face one another in a line
v perform a contradance
contredanse.translation: n. 对面舞, 对面舞曲(三至四或六至八拍的)

contrefilet.translation: <法> n.(腰顶端部的)小牛排,前腰小牛排

contretemps.translation: n. 来得不巧的事情, 不幸的意外事, 切分音法
